seo_title: On-Premise LLM: Private and Secure AI for B2B SMEs
seo_desc: Avoid GDPR fines. We deploy On-Premise Artificial Intelligence (private LLMs) on your servers to analyze B2B data without relying on OpenAI.
author_pitch: As an AI specialist, I see SMEs exposing their trade secrets on ChatGPT daily. I will design a RAG architecture with Open Source models on your own server so you can leverage the full power of AI without compromising a single data point.
title: B2B On-Premise AI Agent: Shield Your Data and Ensure GDPR Compliance
body:
Are you uploading confidential contracts and financial reports to ChatGPT without considering the consequences?

Every time your team uses public APIs to summarize commercial agreements or analyze patient histories, you are handing over your business secrets to third-party servers. For clinics, law firms, and B2B companies, this constant exposure not only destroys competitive advantage but also opens the door to catastrophic audits and massive fines for violating the GDPR.

The trap of Public Artificial Intelligence

Relying on massive cloud services means your most critical data is used to train other companies' models, resulting in a total loss of control over your information. True digital sovereignty is not rented by tokens, it is built in-house.

Our solution: Custom On-Premise LLM

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we deploy open-source language models directly onto your own secure servers. We design an isolated Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture with no internet connection required, ensuring your AI works exclusively for you.

  1. Total network isolation: We deploy the model in a private VPS environment or physical server within your company, guaranteeing that no data leaves your infrastructure.
  2. Hyper-specialized RAG engines: We connect the local LLM with your database and ERP so it responds based solely on your internal corporate documentation.
  3. Compliance by design: By not sending PII (Personally Identifiable Information) to the US, you automatically comply with strict European GDPR regulations.
  4. Flat inference costs: We eliminate variable billing based on token consumption from public APIs, stabilizing your monthly operational costs.

The Real Impact on B2B Security

  • 100% unbreakable privacy: Your trade secrets and client data never leave your established security perimeter.
  • Autonomous response speed: Millisecond queries without depending on the latency of external servers or outages of third-party services.
  • Protected intellectual property: Your corporate AI assistant learns and improves without enriching the algorithms of your direct competitors.
